project.name: Chattera :: Platform :: Common Security
project.description: Shared OAuth2 resource-server building blocks for every Chattera service that validates Keycloak-issued JWTs: a JwtAuthenticationConverter that maps the token's realm_access.roles claim to Spring authorities, exposed as a Spring Boot auto-configuration so consuming services get it for free by adding this dependency plus spring-boot-starter-oauth2-resource-server. Each service still owns its own SecurityFilterChain (permitted paths differ per service); only the role-mapping converter is shared here.
